items.title: Chandrayaan-3 lander module generated ‘ejecta halo’ on lunar surface during landing: ISRO study
items.snippet_en: ISRO's Chandrayaan-3 lander module, Vikram, successfully soft-landed near the Moon's south pole on 23 August 2023, making India the fourth country to achieve a lunar soft landing and the first in history to land in the lunar polar region.

items.title: India lands spacecraft near south pole of moon in world first
items.snippet_en: Chandrayaan-3's Vikram lander touched down shortly after 6:00 p.m. IST on 23 August 2023 near the Moon's south pole, making India the first country to land a spacecraft near the lunar south pole.

items.title: Chandrayaan-3: India makes historic landing near Moon's south pole
items.snippet_en: Chandrayaan-3's Vikram lander made a historic touchdown at 18:04 local time on 23 August 2023, making India the first nation to successfully land in the lunar south pole region and fourth to achieve a lunar soft landing.

items.title: India on the moon! Chandrayaan-3 becomes 1st probe to land near lunar south pole
items.snippet_en: ISRO's Chandrayaan-3 successfully touched down near the lunar south pole at 6:03 p.m. IST on 23 August 2023, establishing India as the first country to land near the Moon's south pole.

outputs.notes_en: All sources verify that Chandrayaan-3's Vikram lander touched down on 23 August 2023, making India the first nation to land in the lunar south pole region.
